title: Public items in all 6 crates missing doc comments — docs are the contract
description: Multiple public items across the workspace lack doc comments entirely. Specific examples observed: (1) mime-tree: TransferEncoding enum variants (SevenBit, EightBit, Binary, etc.) have no docs explaining when each is set or what it means for decode_body_value; (2) uuencoding: ScannedBlock fields (begin_line_offset, data_start_offset) have no docs explaining what 'offset' means (into original input? into the body portion?); (3) yencoding: EncodePartOptions fields have no docs for line_length (what is the unit — bytes before encoding, characters after?); (4) smime-tree: KeyWrapAlgorithm variants have no docs; KariKeyAgreement fields have no docs. Missing docs are missing contract clauses — callers must guess the semantics or read the source. This is a broad issue affecting all six crates. The minimum fix is a doc comment on every public item (field, variant, function, struct, enum, trait method) that describes what callers can rely on, not implementation details.
close_reason: P2 doc coverage: comprehensive doc comments across all 6 crates is a large effort tracked separately. The most critical public types and functions already have docs. Incremental improvement over time.
